title: Restaurant-ready sign in
brief: Design-only response to the user's rejection of the developer-looking sign-in screenshot. Audience: restaurant staff. Three structurally different hospitality-facing directions using the extracted project palette. Replace generated/local/setup language with clear restaurant-facing copy; preserve email/password entry, generic error feedback and accessible controls. Include default/error/loading and light/dark previews. All sample menu content is fictional, no account calls, real credentials, unsupported signup/SSO/reset flows, external assets or live app changes. The Service wordmark is a proposed presentation of the existing Service desk identity. Preview controls and mock submission code are design-only (data-preview-only): exclude them from any live implementation. A future implementation must retain the existing real sign-in action, field validation and route-local Suspense, not copy the prototype's dialog form method or simulated outcomes. Recommend The pass.

artboards.title: The pass — recommended
artboards.tradeoff: A confident hospitality identity and a focused sign-in area; the editorial illustration gives way to the form on mobile.

artboards.title: The host
artboards.tradeoff: Quiet, lightweight and directly focused on the form at every screen size; less distinctive storytelling than the split-screen direction.

artboards.title: The counter
artboards.tradeoff: A tangible menu preview makes the product's purpose clear; the more informative desktop composition is busier and collapses to a compact introduction on mobile.
